Solution 14[edit]

Set n =⌊x⌋. Then n^2 - 3x + 2 = 0 gives x = (n^2 + 2)/2.

For this to work, we need n ≤ (n^2 + 2)/2 < n + 1.

The left side, n^2 - 3n + 2 ≥ 0, holds for every integer n.

The right side, n^2 −3n − 1 < 0, holds only for n∈{0,1,2,3}. Those give distinct values total.
